right_arm: none on the rig; reported to Dream parked at the arm file's rest, grip 1 (open); its answers are dropped

speed.retime: each row and approach leg split into equal 20 Hz substeps, all joints arriving together

missing_slots: wrist_l (camera 'wrist' is not in the record)

trips.joint_clamp: every target clipped 1.0 deg inside the motor limits (a notice, not a stop)
trips.jump: any arm joint target > 20.0 deg from the last -> refuse chunk, stop
trips.workspace_box: workspace_box_viscous_waterproof_01.json: tcp/wrist/wrist_pitch/elbow boxes on every substep -> refuse chunk, stop
trips.tank_guard: every substep through makermodslab.tank_guard GuardedTargets.step (rejected -> stop) and every measured pose through monitor()
trips.lag: measured vs commanded > 10.0 deg on any arm joint for 2 ticks
trips.torque: |torque| > 5.0 Nm for 2 ticks, or > 3.5 Nm for 2.0 s
trips.feedback: no fresh reply / motor fault / camera read error -> stop
trips.dream: Dream error or a malformed / non-finite chunk -> stop
trips.inputs_unchecked: first request refused locally (nothing sent) unless ~/.dreamlabs/inputs_checked holds its id
trips.start_gate: measured rest within 5.0 deg of limits and through the guard; the Dream start pose inside the limits and the box
trips.speed: any planned arm substep faster than 15.0 deg/s -> stop
trips.stop: every exit (trips, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP, stop_button.py): gripper torque off at once, then the six arm joints back to the measured rest leg by leg at the speed cap (guard-checked legs; not clear -> hold), then all torque off; a second signal aborts the return and releases.

run: rehearse: approach, hold at the start pose, stop; no Dream

approach.from: the measured rest (lying on the tank floor)
approach.route: core.approach_waypoints: lift shoulder/fold elbow first, then straight to the start pose
